intro: Whether you're hosting movie nights or winding down solo, our TuneIn offers custom comfort, smart charging, and sleek storage—all in one thoughtful design that adjusts to you with just a touch.

features.title: Recline with a touch
features.text: With a single button, shift into full relaxation. Adjust your seat, lumbar, and head support to find your perfect, personalized comfort zone.

features.title: Power in your palm
features.text: Stay charged while you unwind—integrated USB-A, USB-C, and wireless charging pads keep all your devices powered and ready.

features.title: A place for everything
features.text: The center console has room for your remotes, chargers, and snacks—plus hidden cupholders to keep your evenings mess-free.

features.title: Support that follows you
features.text: Motorized lumbar and headrest adjustment let you fine-tune your posture—from reading to napping, it’s comfort on your terms.

features.title: Sculpted for serenity
features.text: Wrapped in soft, easy-to-maintain fabric, the dual-tone upholstery creates a look that’s as cozy as it is contemporary.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Tunein Motorised 3-Seater Fabric Recliner With Left Hand Console
